AKTA DADAH BERBAHAYA 1952
PERINTAH DADAH BERBAHAYA 1981

PEMBETULAN

DaaM P.U. (A) 69 yang disiarkan pada 19hb Mac 1981 gantikan
"Perintah Dadah Berbahaya 1981" dengan "Perintah Dadah
Berbahaya (Pindaan) 1981" yang terdapat di tajuk kecil dan
perenggan 1.

(KKM. 55 (58) Bhg. 5; PN. (PU?) 214 Pt. IIT.)

DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT 1952
DANGEROUS DRUGS ORDER 1981

CORRIGENDUM

In P.U. (A) 69 published on the 19th March 1981 substitute
"Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Order 1981" for "Dangerous
Drugs Order 1981" appearing in the sub-heading and paragraph 1.

(KKM. 55 (58) Bhg. 5; PN. (PU?) 214 Pt. IIT.)
